_fixture: MOCK RESPONSE - NOT A LIVE-SOURCE TEST
_what_this_is: A constructed HTTP 500 body for D2-S03 failure drills. Serve it with status 500 and Content-Type application/vnd.sdmx.data+json from a local stub or a monkeypatched requests.get. Nothing here was returned by the OECD.
_honesty_note: No HTTP 500 was ever observed from sdmx.oecd.org during this work. The envelope below mirrors the top-level shape of a real OECD SDMX-JSON 2.0 data message (meta / data / errors) so that a parser written against the real format still recognises it. The error codes and text are invented and are NOT an OECD error catalogue.
_expected_handling: status_code != 200 must stop processing BEFORE json.loads(). The refresh must report 'live refresh failed' and must leave any existing good cache untouched, keeping that cache's original retrieved_at_utc.
